description: This Java class implements a drag-and-drop listener for images, handling various drag events such as start, entered, location, exited, drop, and ended. It manages visual feedback via background color changes and sets image content upon drop.

classes.name: ImageDragListener
classes.description: Implements drag listener for view components, managing background color states and setting images from dropped data.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Handles drag events and updates UI accordingly based on the event action.

methods.name: setTargetColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the view to indicate drag state.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Processes the drop event, retrieves URI from ClipData, and sets the image URI if applicable.

methods.name: processLocation
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling drag location updates; does nothing by default.

methods.name: setImageUri
methods.description: Sets the image URI for an ImageView if the view is of type ImageView.
